nodes.title: Has a service booking tomorrow
nodes.detail: Calls the day before to confirm, and reschedules or cancels in the same call, only where it replaces the service advisor’s call, not on top of it.
nodes.notes: Open (Aftersales workshop): Do service advisors call before every booking today? Should the AI agent’s call replace theirs?
